premises.text: Current talent assessment methods favor prestige over potential
premises.evidence_span: evaluation today are based on criteria such as well-known schools or well-known companies. They favor prestige over potential.

premises.text: Deep learning technology can qualify diverse experiences in resumes
premises.evidence_span: Our unique deep learning technology is able to qualify every experience, project, education or transition people can write down in their resumes.

premises.text: The system can assess both technical and non-technical jobs across all languages
premises.evidence_span: we are able to assess both technical and non-technical jobs. We are able to scale to all languages.

premises.text: Reminder can process applications from various media formats
premises.evidence_span: we can deal with all media formats from PDF to images.

premises.text: Clients can identify more relevant talents and reduce interview numbers
premises.evidence_span: We allow our clients identify three times more relevant talents in their initial pools and reduce by 80% the number of interviews they do before making a hiring decision.

premises.text: The pricing model is scalable based on client growth
premises.evidence_span: our pricing start only at $99 and scales as you grow.

value.text: Talent assessment becomes more equitable and effective through deep learning

notes: Beta status and processing metrics are excluded as traction.
